title: The Geometry of Learning: Read-Write Asymmetry Across Training
abstract: arXiv:2605.16600v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Pretraining and alignment update the same transformer weights, and we ask in which directions each stage changes them. The residual stream gives every matrix a shared coordinate system, in which a weight change can be compared with the principal subspace of the activations the matrix reads and with the prediction subspace of the unembedding. In this frame, alignment updates to the query and key matrices are enriched in the principal input subspace, while its updates to the output matrices are close to random relative to the prediction subspace, and the same signature appears in late pretraining and under every objective we apply to one checkpoint, so it is a property of the training stage rather than of the objective. The gradient of a linear map is a sum of outer products $\delta_t a_t^\top$, and the residual stream enters this product through the activation $a_t$ for matrices that read from it and through the upstream gradien

translated_title: 学习的几何学：训练过程中的读写不对称性
translated_abstract: 预训练和对齐更新的是同一个 transformer 的权重，我们探究每个阶段分别在哪些方向上改变了这些权重。残差流为每个矩阵提供了一个共享的坐标系，在这一坐标系中，权重的变化既可以与该矩阵所读取的激活值的主子空间进行比较，也可以与 unembedding 的预测子空间进行比较。在这一框架下，对齐阶段对 query 和 key 矩阵的更新主要富集于主输入子空间中，而其对输出矩阵的更新相对于预测子空间则接近随机；同样的特征也出现在预训练后期，以及我们对同一检查点施加的每一种训练目标之下，因此这是训练阶段的属性，而非训练目标的属性。线性映射的梯度是外积 $\delta_t a_t^\top$ 之和，残差流对于从中读取信息的矩阵通过激活值 $a_t$ 进入该乘积，而对于（写向它的矩阵）则通过上游梯度……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文以残差流为共享坐标系分析预训练与对齐阶段对 transformer 权重的更新方向，揭示了“读写不对称性”：读侧矩阵（query/key）的更新集中于其输入激活的主子空间，而写侧矩阵（输出矩阵）的更新相对于预测子空间接近随机，且这一特征是训练阶段的属性而非训练目标的属性。
en_tdlr: Using the residual stream as a shared coordinate system, this paper reveals a read-write asymmetry across training: updates to reading matrices (query/key) concentrate in the principal input subspace while updates to output matrices are near-random relative to the prediction subspace — a signature of the training stage rather than of the objective.
